author: dreambig5
body:
Just make a new account & start again. You'll easily reach that lvl quick and you get to learn about all the new activities.

edit: I meant this sincerely. I took few years break and when I got back, I too felt overwhelmed but this was the easiest way to catch up to the changes.

author: 3rategy
body: Try seeing what your main quest is, and try accomplish that. Visit seeker mara in resting place if it doesn't show up. Otherwise, just beat the hell out of whatever bosses you see, level up, do memory hunts for orns when you need em fast, and have fun. Clear what dungeons you can too. Monuments are also very good. Enjoy!

author: MysticSheep42
body:
Honestly, the first chunk up to 150 is really quick.... I had an exceptionally old character (hadn't played in years) and so much of the game had changed. 

My character was level 136. My bf started playong a new character the same day. He thought it woukd be easier to relearn then hopping onto his character, which was around 140 and whom he hadn't played in years either. 

Turns out.... he was right. 

So the next day i started and he was about 10 levels higher than ne all the way up to level 225. 

He is now level 226. I am 221. 

It's easy to level early on and the game walks you through the beginning, which for us was easier to navigate guilds and character build. 

If you choose to not start over, I'd  suggest finding a guild that is active. I find ones with Discord are best to ensure activity and also a great way to get more immediate help. The size of the guild is important for having access to guild raids also, which can really help where it comes to finding armor and weapons that you'd not be anle to access on your own. 

Also, explore the added classes. Earlier on, you complete challenges just by taking them, so you make back the orna it costs to invest in them. 

Build your city up, and get a conquorers guild up if you haven't already. Then, ocus on conquering any spots on the lower level for encampments. The highest ranking person sets the reward, but for every spot you hold, you cam then go to your guild daily and get a reward. 

Thats all I got for now. It's late. But, I play a lot. I play a lot, feel free to chat in game. Once you get 150 I think? You can build a way vessel.  Make friends and utilize the vessel to hop over to other people's towns too :)
